product.description: O serie de infracțiuni minore comise într-un cămin de studenți nu par, în mod normal, genul de caz de care se ocupă Hercule Poirot. Un pantof, un inel cu diamant, o pereche de pantaloni vechi, un stetoscop și alte mărunțișuri furate, o eșarfă și un rucsac tăiate în bucăți ndash; delicte prea neînsemnate pentru a fi anunțată poliția și chiar mai puțin demne de geniul lui Poirot. Totuși, lista acestor lucruri este atât de bizară, încât îi trezește interesul celebrului detectiv. Din nou intuiția lui se dovedește corectă, căci un simplu caz de cleptomanie pavează drumul către crimă...

Dive into a captivating blend of suspense and classic detection with *The Bad Clock on Hickory Street*. This engaging mystery novel by Litera plunges readers into the unexpected world of minor thefts that quickly escalate into something far more sinister.

While Hercule Poirot is accustomed to grand, complex criminal cases, the initial incidents explored in this book are decidedly small. The stolen goodsâa single shoe, a diamond ring, an old pair of pants, a stethoscope, and various other trinketsâare too insignificant for police to take notice, and seemingly beneath the genius of Poirot himself.

## Unraveling the Mystery: From Kleptomania to Crime

The mystery begins with a seemingly trivial list of items stolen from a student dormitory. These small details build into an irresistible puzzle that ultimately captures the attention of the celebrated detective.

*The Bad Clock on Hickory Street* masterfully follows the journey as Poirot realizes these minor acts of theft are anything but random. What starts as a case of petty kleptomania soon reveals itself to be a carefully constructed facade, paving the way for a complex and dangerous crime. If you enjoy classic detective fiction filled with psychological suspense and brilliant deductions, this is a must-read addition to your library.

## Why Read This Litera Novel?

If you are searching for high-quality mystery novels that blend historical settings with gripping modern suspense, this title delivers. The narrative structure uses the seemingly mundaneâthe list of lost itemsâto build immense tension, challenging readers and mirroring Poirot's own insightful investigation.
